API.KL: Full frozen rollout reevaluated at epoch end, nonnegative estimator mean(exp(logratio)-1-logratio); stops additional epochs above target.
API.completed_episodes: flat deep-copied episode-info records with zero-based rollout_step
API.description: PPOConfig.description() is JSON-compatible and records exact loss/normalization/KL/audit conventions.
API.explained_variance: Frozen-rollout predictions versus GAE returns; JSON null when target variance<=1e-12.
API.progress: optional dict mutated with state/in_update/complete/phase/zero-based epoch and minibatch/actual optimizer_steps/epochs_completed; updated immediately after optimizer.step before later guard
API.reset_info: events with rollout_step, indices, info; trainer logs initial seeds separately
API.rollout_storage: CPU-owned detached tensors; mandatory collected raw_rewards float32 and score_delta_raw_fixed/alive_raw_frames/elapsed_raw_frames int64.
